# Danin: Vi tror på risktillgångar nu

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-09-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Katrin Danin, a senior strategist at Söderberg & Partners, joins to discuss the rise in US rates after a strong PMI print and the gap between the Riksbank's policy-rate path (around 2%) and market pricing (close to 3%). She expects the Riksbank to hold today and says the market's roughly five priced-in hikes are too many. Söderberg & Partners stays positive on risk assets, especially global equities and emerging markets, citing strong earnings growth driven by the AI build-out, recommends neutral duration and likes credit bonds; host Ulf is more cautious, calling AI valuations somewhat hyped.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host Ulf is cautious: AI fundamentals are strong (Nvidia to double profits) but valuations look hyped.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion: nothing at company level suggests the AI trend is slowing, and Nvidia guides to doubling profits. Ulf still finds the sums and valuations very high and 'lite väl haussigt'. He admits it has been wrong to be cautious so far. The guest is positive on tech overall. Net result is a cautious watch, not a sell.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI capex growth slows
- if earnings fail to meet very high 2027 growth expectations

> *"Men jag vet inte, jag tycker det börjar bli lite väl haussigt."*

---

### 🟠 000660.KS — SK Hynix | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest notes supply shortages persisting to 2030 per the CEO; she is positive on EM tech exposure at cheaper valuations.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion: Söderberg & Partners rates emerging markets positive as a cheaper way to get tech/AI exposure than Western markets. SK Hynix is highlighted as a top EM constituent with structural memory shortages that its CEO says will last to 2030. This is an indirect, sector-level view rather than an explicit stock recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if memory shortages ease earlier than expected
- if AI demand slows

> *"det bolagets vd var ju ute och sa att det här kommer råda åtminstone till 2030"*
